name: player_actor_vtable
evidence: Read live from the player actor's +0xe8 while the game was running. Verified statically: .rodata+0xf4 and +0x2bc of this table hold exactly the two function addresses the running game reported.

name: ksys::act::Actor::getMaxLife
evidence: Player actor vtable slot +0xf4. Whole body is `lwz r3,0x1320(r3); blr` - returns *(s32*)(actor+0x1320). Cross-checked three ways: the live actor's vtable slot resolved here, .rodata 0x101e60f0 contains it, and it returns sane values in-game. Returns a CACHE; correct for reading, useless as a write target.

name: ksys::act::Actor::getLife
evidence: Player actor vtable slot +0x2bc. Whole body is `addi r3,r3,0x540; blr` - returns &actor->life. Confirmed at runtime: the running game reported its life pointer at exactly actor+0x540. .rodata 0x101e62b8 contains this address.

name: unnamed_getter_actor_0x544
evidence: Whole body is `lwz r3,0x544(r3); blr` - returns *(s32*)(actor+0x544). Behaviour certain, C++ name not: it is not the vtable slot adjacent to getLife (+0x2c0 is null). Recorded because this is the field an earlier SetMaxLife bug corrupted by writing pLife[1]; it is live actor state, not padding.

name: life
evidence: s32, current life in raw units (4 per heart). From getLife's `addi r3,r3,0x540`, matched by the running game reporting lifePtrOffset=0x540. Genuine storage - writing it works.

name: max_life
evidence: s32, max life in raw units - a CACHE, not storage, and not one that self-heals. From getMaxLife's `lwz r3,0x1320(r3)`; the offset is certain. Writing it does not stick: it reverts and the HUD plays the heart-container-removed (Horned Statue) effect. NOTE an earlier guess that the game refreshes this from the flag every tick is WRONG - setting the flag alone left this stale (flag=24 while this read 20). Use PlayerInfo::setMaxHeartValue, which writes flag and caches together.

name: unknown_actor_0x544
evidence: s32 with a dedicated getter at 0x02d79978. Sits immediately after life (+0x540). Purpose unidentified. Explicitly NOT max life - writing max life here crashes the game.

name: vtable
evidence: Primary actor vtable pointer. Pre-existing module knowledge, re-confirmed live: the value read here resolved to 0x101e5ffc and its slots matched the binary.

name: ksys::gdt::setFlag_MaxHartValue
evidence: Found by following the flag-handle initialiser: FUN_02de6bf4 calls 0x02e2213c (returns the literal "MaxHartValue"), passes it to getS32Handle, and stores the resulting handle to 0x10466ad4. The only other two functions referencing that global are this pair. Body is `setS32(param_1, DAT_10466ad4, param_2)` - value, handle, debug, matching the decompiled `setFlag_MaxHartValue(s32 value, bool debug)`. Signature: void(s32 value, bool debug). Exercised in-game: calling the setter moved the flag from 20 to 24 and the getter read 24 back on a later call. NOTE the write is NOT observable synchronously - re-reading the flag immediately after setting it still returns the old value.

name: ksys::gdt::getFlag_MaxHartValue
evidence: Found by following the flag-handle initialiser: FUN_02de6bf4 calls 0x02e2213c (returns the literal "MaxHartValue"), passes it to getS32Handle, and stores the resulting handle to 0x10466ad4. The only other two functions referencing that global are this pair. Body is `getS32(DAT_10466ad4, param_1)` - handle then debug, matching the decompiled `s32 getFlag_MaxHartValue(bool debug)`. Signature: s32(bool debug). Exercised in-game: calling the setter moved the flag from 20 to 24 and the getter read 24 back on a later call. NOTE the write is NOT observable synchronously - re-reading the flag immediately after setting it still returns the old value.

name: ksys::gdt::setS32
evidence: Generic typed flag setter, reached from setFlag_MaxHartValue. Signature: void(s32 value, FlagHandle handle, bool debug). Argument order matches the decomp.

name: ksys::gdt::getS32
evidence: Generic typed flag getter, reached from getFlag_MaxHartValue. Signature: s32(FlagHandle handle, bool debug).

name: ksys::gdt::Manager::getS32Handle
evidence: Called during flag-handle init as getS32Handle(mgr, name) with a sead string built from the flag-name literal; its return is stored into the per-flag handle global. Matches `mgr->getS32Handle("MaxHartValue")`.

name: gdt_flagname_MaxHartValue
evidence: Whole body returns the string literal "MaxHartValue" (at 0x10202814). One of a run of per-flag name accessors; the next is at 0x02e22148.

name: ksys::gdt::flag_MaxHartValue_handle
evidence: FlagHandle for MaxHartValue, in .data. Written once by the initialiser at 0x02e05564 (`stw r8,0x6ad4(r11)` with r11=0x1046) and read only by the get/set wrappers. Neighbouring handles sit 4 bytes apart (previous is 0x10466ad0).

name: "MaxHartValue"
evidence: GameData flag name for max hearts, in quarter-hearts (4 per heart). Authoritative, save-backed storage for max life; Actor+0x1320 is only a cache of it.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::setMaxHeartValue
evidence: void(PlayerInfo* this, s32 quarter_hearts). Body is exactly the decompiled `{ gdt::setFlag_MaxHartValue(v); mMaxHeartValue = (f32)v; }` - a call to 0x02e1a1f0 followed by a float store to this+0x64 via the standard PPC signed-int-to-double idiom. The only caller of setFlag_MaxHartValue. THIS is the correct entry point for changing max hearts; confirmed working in-game.

name: ksys::act::PlayerInfo::sInstance
evidence: Pointer to the PlayerInfo singleton, in .data. Both callers of setMaxHeartValue load `this` from here and null-check first: 0x02b76718 (`lis r31,0x1046; lwz r31,0x3f38(r31)`) and 0x022a9920 (`lis r29,0x1046; lwzu r3,0x3f38(r29)`). Two independent confirmations.

name: mMaxHeartValue
evidence: f32 cache of the MaxHartValue flag. From the float store at the end of setMaxHeartValue (0x02d4992c). Matches the decomp's PlayerInfo::mMaxHeartValue, also an f32 holding quarter-hearts.
